name: Aarav Sharma
review: Tripplankaro nailed our Nainital and Corbett trip! Everything from the private cab driver to the riverside resort was arranged smoothly. WhatsApp coordination was instant whenever we needed local food recommendations.

name: Priya & Rohan Patel
review: Our Kashmir honeymoon felt like a Bollywood dream! The Gulmarg gondola Phase 2 tickets were sorted, and the Dal Lake wooden houseboat was pure magic. No hidden costs whatsoever.

name: Tanmay Verma
review: Booked our college graduation trip to North Goa through Tripplankaro. Stayed in cozy private villas near Vagator. The squad bill splitter feature on their site was super handy too!

name: Ananya Sen
review: The Munnar tea estate homestay and the Alleppey private houseboat chef were 10/10. Tripplankaro gave us a customized plan within 20 minutes on WhatsApp.

name: Devansh Singhania
review: First time travelling abroad with family. Desert safari dune bashing, Burj Khalifa at 124th floor, and hotel near Dubai Marina were all seamless. Loved their transparent pricing.

name: Sneha Kulkarni
review: Had a fantastic workation and snow holiday in Old Manali and Sissu through the Atal Tunnel. Warm hosts, great vehicle and zero stress.
